_about: A short script for scripts/test-lock-extract.mjs (docs/LOCK-EXTRACT.md §4). Invented. Three scenes: a kitchen, a street with a crowd, a bus. Elements are the shape of src/data/sample.dragon.script.json.

elements.text: Maya, 20s, pours tea. A kettle whistles.
Forty STUDENTS (40) crowd the stop. A bus waits, a red bicycle leans on the pole.
Maya sits by the window with a rucksack.
